landing.tagline: Learn C# and .NET by playing — from your first Console.WriteLine to Blazor, MAUI and beyond.
landing.setupText: Google login is not configured yet. Add your Google OAuth ClientId/ClientSecret to appsettings.json (see README), or use the development login below.
landing.feature1: Bit, your AI tutor robot, gives you smart hints — and talks!
landing.feature2: Earn XP, keep your daily streak and climb the leaderboard.
landing.feature3: 12 worlds: basics, CLI, EF Core, Web APIs, Blazor, WPF, MAUI...
landing.feature4: Write and run real C# code right in your browser, safely.
